registration: Frozen before study table execution; source inspection and engineering pilots already occurred. This is not a blinded external preregistration.
multiplicity: Twelve domain questions; descriptive intervals and null findings retained. No omnibus pandemic effect. Selected GWAS BH is scoped to selected variants.

studies.title: Excess mortality and official reports
studies.hypothesis: WHO modeled excess deaths exceed reported COVID deaths in most jointly covered country-years.
studies.comparison: 2020 and 2021 joint populations; alternate WHO releases
studies.missingness: Do not fill absent WHO reports; report nonmissing report weeks
studies.intervals: Published WHO annual 95 percent intervals; no sums of marginal bounds

studies.title: Reporting corrections and observation gaps
studies.hypothesis: Negative report corrections and missing weeks are nonuniform across reporting areas.
studies.comparison: WHO case and death series; per-area missingness, signed corrections and reporting-era changes
studies.missingness: Blank remains absent, including runs of absent reports
studies.intervals: Exact finite-panel counts; no population sampling confidence claim
studies.practical: Any correction changes cumulative aggregation; gaps above 20 percent flag limited support

studies.title: Age-standardized mortality contrasts
studies.hypothesis: Direct age standardization changes at least one crude country mortality contrast.
studies.comparison: WHO 2022 modeled age and sex counts and Nx for USA and GBR; common pooled 2020 standard
studies.missingness: Require identical age bins and positive Nx; do not bridge changed 2023 bins
studies.intervals: Poisson approximation is a numerical sensitivity, excludes WHO model covariance
studies.support: Model-based age-specific mortality, not observed racial disparity

studies.title: Unequal work and mobility exposure
studies.hypothesis: Employment trajectories and workplace mobility expose different populations and cannot be equated.
studies.comparison: Annual employment estimates and available aggregate workplace mobility within source geography
studies.missingness: No country or year extrapolation across unavailable mobility coverage
studies.intervals: Source estimates; no invented mobility sampling intervals
studies.practical: Definitions and coverage determine eligible contrasts
studies.support: Scope limited by lawful mobility acquisition

studies.title: Routine health service disruption
studies.hypothesis: DTP coverage in 2021 is below its 2010-2019 trend in more than half of eligible countries.
studies.comparison: DTP observed estimates versus prespecified predictive no-shock trend; local-level sensitivity
studies.missingness: At least eight pre-period years and 2021 outcome
studies.intervals: Predictive trend bands; do not call them causal intervals

studies.title: Comparative school closure timing
studies.hypothesis: Full closure timing supports eligible group-time comparisons with annual employment.
studies.comparison: Oxford adoption cohorts versus not-yet-treated places with support checks
studies.missingness: At least five treated and five controls; four pre-period years for trend check
studies.intervals: Country bootstrap where eligible; null estimates where unsupported
studies.support: Candidate causal design; identification must be defended separately

studies.title: Employment recovery
studies.hypothesis: 2023 employment remains below 2019 in at least one quarter of jointly measured countries.
studies.comparison: Matched country estimates in 2019, 2020 and 2023; 2024 sensitivity
studies.missingness: Complete matched pairs only; publish excluded countries
studies.intervals: Country bootstrap of descriptive average changes

studies.title: Real output recovery and missing hours
studies.hypothesis: Real per-person GDP recovery varies across countries and cannot identify hours lost.
studies.comparison: Constant 2015 USD GDP per person 2019, 2020, 2023; alternative 2024 endpoints
studies.missingness: Matched positive GDP values; never substitute nominal GDP
studies.practical: Five percent real output per person

studies.title: School policy and enrollment
studies.hypothesis: School policy and gross secondary enrollment do not establish matched learning loss.
studies.comparison: Oxford closure exposure and matched WDI enrollment endpoints
studies.missingness: No interpolation of missing school observations
studies.intervals: Country bootstrap of enrollment change; source definition limitations
studies.support: Enrollment and closure policy; no remote instruction or learning assessment data

studies.title: Mental health survey changes
studies.hypothesis: Within-phase symptom changes differ across US source-defined groups.
studies.comparison: Household Pulse first and last wave within each phase and geography
studies.missingness: Provider suppression retained; no pre-2020 matched baseline
studies.intervals: Published marginal intervals; conservative unknown-covariance change envelope
studies.support: Published weighted aggregates; design weight recomputation unavailable

studies.title: Viral phase heterogeneity
studies.hypothesis: Weighted lineage composition changes over the archived CDC observation window.
studies.comparison: One frozen national weighted publication; reliable lineage estimates over time
studies.missingness: Unreliable cells suppressed; no submission counts as prevalence
studies.intervals: CDC published uncertainty; no sums across overlapping lineage labels
studies.practical: Dominant lineage change within comparable interval definitions
studies.support: US national aggregate viral evidence only

studies.title: Aggregate host genetics methods
studies.hypothesis: Allele harmonization and ambiguous-strand exclusions materially affect aggregate concordance.
studies.comparison: HGI A2 and B2 released selected variants; GRCh38 and effect-allele checks
studies.missingness: Exclude mismatches, ambiguous common palindromic variants and absent overlap
studies.intervals: Published beta/SE Wald intervals; selected-set BH scope explicit
studies.practical: Any incorrect effect sign invalidates an association comparison
studies.support: Technical interpretation, not independent replication or geographic genetic explanation
